headlines.title: Rescuers Search for Hundreds in Nepal Floods; More Rain Looms
headlines.description: Two days after catastrophic floods hit Nepal, the desperate search continues for survivors, with rescuers crawling through mud to reach those still trapped. It comes amid a new threat of rainfall that could breach a dammed lake. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports from Nepal.

headlines.title: Trump calls into the International Space Station from NASA Mission Control
headlines.description: President Trump became the first sitting president to call into the International Space Station from NASA's Mission Control, thanking all aboard the station for their service and dedication.

headlines.title: Kevin Warsh walks a fine line on inflation in key speech
headlines.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said measures of inflation are still elevated, but it is not yet clear that the Fed must take action to address rising prices.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy is ‘scared’ as jury in her murder trial continues deliberations
headlines.description: PLYMOUTH, Mass. — Lindsay Clancy is “scared” as the jury continues its second day of deliberations to determine whether she is guilty of killing her three children in 2023, her defense lawyer said Friday.

headlines.title: Chicago woman reunited with her dog after 12 years
headlines.description: A Chicago woman was reunited her dog after 12 years thanks to the chihuahua’s microchip. WMAQ’s Rose Schmidt reports.

headlines.title: Patient battles insurance over coverage for tumor removal
headlines.description: Patient battles insurance over coverage for tumor removal In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports on short-term insurance plans, which, unlike most other health plans, are not required to cover pre-existing conditions. headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Trump signs order to create space-focused military academy
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Friday announced that he would sign an executive order to create a new military academy, the U.S. Space Academy.
